_note: Defender for Office 365 Safe Links is an Exchange Online Protection policy, not an ARM/Bicep resource — deployed via the ExchangeOnlineManagement PowerShell module's New-SafeLinksPolicy cmdlet. This file documents the exact parameters that script applies; see deploy-email-security.ps1.
description: Time-of-click URL rewriting and scanning for all users — the direct mitigation for the safelinks-clickthrough-despite-warning.kql detection, which only fires when a user proceeds past this policy's own warning page.

settings.custom_note: AllowClickThrough=false is the deliberate hardening choice — the default Microsoft setting actually allows click-through with a warning. Setting it false means a malicious link is blocked outright, not just discouraged, which removes the exact 'user clicked through anyway' scenario the detection rule exists to catch as a secondary control.

exceptions: security-testing-mailbox@domain.example — excluded so phishing simulation campaigns aren't blocked
